content: Bitlus a dlǝmi Mi' bǝtl Yesu kal ki Ulshelima shilin i
Mi'shinkǝn ne' yelsǝni gini ge' atl ki Yahudiya nǝs kumi, mi' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawai u sa ndǝ' nǝ shilǝn ki Lya i.
Nǝ Bitlus mbǝ Ulshelima u, ginǝs ndǝ' nǝ sǝlkǝn u is shimi' shilǝn,
is usu, “I ngu ka te libi ɗǝ min ginǝ bǝ sa sǝlsiwai u i, i' ɗami ne'si.”
I Bitlus gop dlǝmissi mus shilǝn nisi,
“Ami, a ge' gatl ki Yapa ami shilǝn nǝ Lya, i tlu'ti mbi ni, yayen ulǝn sul lya ɗǝ sussuɗi kǝnǝ bal ul idla mbalǝn, tuge' malgǝn upsi, i mbǝ ma'kǝni.
Na wutti' dwaɗǝn u, yayen tlu ki dǝlgǝn nǝ ki ban mi' asǝn upsi ki ge dǝp lǝɓa, ne' mi'dǝl tugi, ne' yadlǝ a giɓi.
Ya kum yalon ah ulǝnsu i', ‘Bitlus. Hilya, ki' poci, aɗami.’
Ya' usu, a nge i, mulban, gaki bezǝn lǝɓawon a tee bi gasonwai.’
I Yal shilǝn sullya ki lop, i' usu, ‘Ulnǝ Lya a li'ni' u, bǝ mbe besniwai.’
I pǝlgu asǝn maki, iki i dǝl uli twalya ɗaɗanu.
Bǝnǝ mantiwai he mbalǝn maki ngi ki dlǝli abidlabi u nǝ amiɗa u, sǝ shinǝnsi ma'kǝni te' Kaisaliya.
I Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ulǝnsu ta zǝga ne'si, bǝnǝ cetl mbadlwai. Yelsǝni gi mǝkka i is zǝga ne' kǝni, illǝ libi ɗǝ muli.
Itl dlǝmimi kan unǝ en mul shinkǝn ki Lya mbǝl gawasi a libi ɗakka u, ti ussu, ‘Pǝshinkǝn swa Yapa sǝttaki Saminu bi, gunǝ simbetti ki Bitlus,
Tǝh dlǝmikkin shilǝn u, nǝ ki nǝ mus libi wagi ki mbi pekǝtl ɗa.’
“Nǝ gopti shilǝn ini, i Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ndesi suɗi, kan unǝ ndemi suɗi te' kalu.
Ya dambǝl shilǝn ki mulban, kan u' nǝ' usu, ‘Yahaya ɓo, nǝ mal kǝn ti pǝli' mbalǝn batisma, kini ɓo nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya kǝn sǝppǝlikini.’
Kan u nǝ Lya bǝlsi manti u ndace nǝ gunǝ bǝlǝnmini u, nǝ la'ti mbatl nǝ mulban Yesu Almasihu u, ami ki wongi ta dlǝli nǝ Lya!”
Nǝs kumi nǝgu u, is hol ulnǝ sǝdlǝmi u, is nal Lya is usu, “Ai, ginǝ' bǝ Yahudawa wai u Lya a bǝlsi pe'ti ɗǝ ge' bezǝn lǝɓa nǝ mbim mbatldli.”
Milbǝtl Lya a Antakiya ki Suliya
Ginǝ dla' ga tǝn gaki bǝna u nǝ nda gunǝ mbǝl tlo Istipanǝs su, is lǝ tyage' atl ki pinikiya, nǝ calgatl ki Kubulus, nǝ gatl ki Antakiya, sǝɗa dlǝmi' mulǝn shilǝn ki Lya wai Yahudawa katl.
Genwasǝn, mbalǝn ki Kubulus ne' ki Kulane, is lǝ Antikiya is go' dlǝmi' mi' ginǝ bǝ Yahudawa wai u, zo' shilǝn tǝn Yesu.
Toh ki Lya tǝnsi, i mbalǝn dǝɓǝli la'mbadli is pal temma' mulban.
I shilǝni mbǝ'ci ge'lu libi ki mi' bǝtl Lya kal ki Ulshelima, iki is shin Balnabas tya Antakiya.
Nǝn mbǝkǝci u i' en ulki zoki u nǝ Lya pǝlisi u, ippǝl hwol tugi, in ndǝllisi mbadli sǝ'dlil nǝ bali tǝn Lya nǝ mus mbadlwasǝn.
Ti mul zo' mbatl kǝni, ki njǝkǝni nǝ Yal ki mbatl ki Lya nǝ la'ti mbadli, i dǝɓǝl mbalǝn mbǝ ma' Mulban.
Iki i Balnabas lǝ tya Talsus ɗǝ ngau Shawulu,
Iki nǝm mbitu, im mbǝlti Antakiya, i hwon njikǝn ɗa Balnabas isi Shawulu asi ma'ga ge' libi ki Lya asi kulci' dǝɓǝl mbalǝn a Antakiya sǝ go' mbe' mi' bǝdl Yesu kal ki Kilista.
To a hwonisi mi'nje shikǝn kǝ Lya en pe'te' Ulshelima is mbǝ Antakiya.
Nǝm age' si, mul shin Agabus, i' hilya il dlǝmi nǝ ndǝl ki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya nǝn pǝtl bal kuzǝn won ge' atl ki gu' kǝ Lomawa. (Pǝlǝn dli ge' hwon ci' gu' ki Kalaudiyas.)
I milkushti dlilli, hu wonngi tǝn ndǝl twasi, tǝnma' ɗǝtl yelsǝni ginǝ ɗǝ dǝb a Yahudiya u.
Nǝgu sǝpǝli, is shin bǝltiwasǝn gaki ɗǝtl mi'kina tu'ma' Balnabas isi shawulu.
